[USER] User is creating a web portal project titled "Smart Reservation System for Multiple Venues."  
[USER] The project description includes developing a reservation system for hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues.  
[USER] The system allows users to search for available spaces, make bookings, and manage their reservations.  
[USER] The system should include features like payment processing, event scheduling, and user feedback.  
[USER] The project will be a microservices web application.  
[USER] Front end technology will be Angular and Bootstrap.  
[USER] Backend technology will be Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Eureka.  
[USER] The database for users will be MySQL.  
[USER] A distributed database like Cassandra will be used to store reservation-related data.  
[USER] The system will use GraphQL API for hotel search functionality.  
[USER] REST API will be used for users and gateway.  
[USER] API testing will be done using MuleSoft.  
[USER] A machine learning microservice will use TensorFlow with Java.  
[USER] CI/CD will involve GitHub for code, Maven for build, Docker for package and publish, and Jenkins for deployment.  
[USER] The project will follow Scrum methodology with 5 sprints, each lasting one week.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The web portal is designed to provide easy access to information, tools, and services related to a specific topic or group of users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The web portal usually has an active audience that can contribute to its development by visiting, registering, and returning to the portal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Users can find and share information, communicate with other members, and personalize their access to the portal.
